title: Throughput Report — Full Wave (15 items)
purpose: Measure end-to-end cycle time for 15-item rewrite wave and compare against S61-S71 baselines.

methodology.selection: Filtered 80 remaining Pack D Section B items. Excluded already-rewritten (20) and already-higher-order items. Selected 15 highest-ROI candidates from distinct topic clusters.
methodology.authoring: Single-script programmatic rewrite (session072_apply_rewrites.js). Each item: named company, named stakeholder, quantified scenario, competing alternatives, 4 choice-specific EW fields, DL-008/026 compliant.
methodology.governance: npm run preflight (T0 + Tclose) + governance guard (54 tests) + npm run pipeline (8 validators).

authoring.result: 15/15 items rewritten. 500 QID stable. Parse PASS.

tclose_preflight.result: Pack D: 500 QID OK, parse OK, 456 Certified

s61_s68.note: Manual field-by-field edits, no automated governance

s70.note: Programmatic batch rewrite, governance overhead excluded from timing

s71.note: Full end-to-end including selection, backup, verification, governance

s72.note: Full end-to-end. Governance overhead amortized across 15 items (vs. 5 in S71). Script execution amortizes fixed costs.

key_finding: S72 throughput (1.1 min/item) exceeds S71 benchmark (3.3 min/item) because fixed governance overhead (preflight, pipeline) is amortized across 15 items instead of 5. Content authoring speed was comparable per-item. Full-wave scaling confirmed viable.
evaluate_rate: 9 Evaluate items in 16.3 min = 33.1 Evaluate items/hour (vs. S71: 17.0/hour)

questions_answered.Q4_throughput_held: YES — full-wave throughput (1.1 min/item) exceeded S71 benchmark (3.3 min/item). Scaling confirmed.
